from fastapi import FastAPI
import httpx, psycopg

app = FastAPI()
DSN = "postgresql://localhost/app"

@app.get("/rates")
async def rates():
    async with httpx.AsyncClient() as c:
        r = await c.get("https://upstream.example/rates")
    return r.json()
